title: Authoritative daily forcing, Gauge representativeness and Q-derived signature contract
purpose: Build the non-leaking forcing and observation-support layer required before Raven-equation-conformant HBV implementation.

formal_forcing.precipitation: CHM_PRE V2.1 daily, frozen full-polygon Reach weights
formal_forcing.temperature_and_pet: TPDC CMFD V2.0 three-hour temp/pres/shum/wind/srad/lrad aggregated at UTC day boundary; daily FAO-56 Penman-Monteith with direct downward radiation
formal_forcing.aet_role: PML V2.2a monthly AET is an auxiliary soft validation target, never daily forcing

gauge_rules.daily_separation_role: Q-derived response signature, not observed groundwater or water age

time_boundary.forcing_read_rule: 2019-2022 frozen climate forcing may be read for integrity and simulation but never for model selection using discharge

forbidden: monthly AET or PET split into artificial daily forcing
daily hydrograph-separation fraction as a likelihood
station-specific hydrologic parameters or Gauge correction in TN hydrology
claiming response components are observed groundwater, old water, new water or water age
